title: SEO Analyst
description:
Zartek is hiring an SEO Analyst (2\-3years) to grow organic traffic and conversions for our websites and a portfolio of client sites. You’ll run audits, execute on\-page and technical fixes, guide content with data\-backed keyword strategies, and report clear impact. You’ll collaborate with developers, designers, and account managers to ship measurable improvements fast.

Responsibilities

* Conduct full SEO audits (technical, on\-page, content, links) and build 30–60–90 day roadmaps
* Perform keyword research, topic clustering, and competitor/SERP analysis; map keywords to pages
* Optimize titles, metas, headers, internal links, images, and structured data (Schema.org)
* Partner with dev/design to resolve crawl/index issues, canonicalization, redirects, CWV and page speed
* Support site launches/migrations with pre/post SEO QA and risk\-free redirect plans
* Plan ethical link acquisition (digital PR, partnerships) and manage local SEO/GBP where relevant
* Create SEO content briefs; review drafts for search intent, E\-E\-A\-T, and topical depth
* Set up and monitor GA4/GSC dashboards; report on KPIs, insights, and next actions to stakeholders
* Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis to identify SEO opportunities.
* Conduct on\-page optimization including meta tags, headers, URL structure, internal linking, and schema markup.
* Manage off\-page SEO strategies such as link building, guest posting, and outreach campaigns.
* Perform technical SEO audits and coordinate with developers to fix crawl, indexation, and performance issues.
* Monitor and report website performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Screaming Frog.
* Optimize content in collaboration with content writers to ensure best SEO practices are implemented.
* Stay updated with the latest search engine algorithms and SEO trends.
* Prepare monthly performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Assist in developing and implementing local SEO and mobile optimization strategies.
* Collaborate with marketing and design teams to enhance overall digital visibility.

Qualifications

* 2\-3 years hands\-on SEO experience (agency or product) with proven ranking/traffic wins
* Proficiency with GA4, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog (or similar), and Ahrefs/SEMrush
* Working knowledge of HTML/CSS basics, sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, hreflang, and schema
* Comfort collaborating with engineering/design; solid communication and brief\-writing skills
* Nice to have: Looker Studio, GTM, PageSpeed/Lighthouse, basic SQL/BigQuery, CRO/heatmaps, and CMS experience (WordPress/Webflow/Shopify)

Job Types: Full\-time, Walk\-In

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How much organic traffic you’ve been able to generate for the website you’re managing?
* How many websites you have handled at a time ?
* What is your expected CTC?
* How soon you can join?
* How will you rate your English communication on 1 to 5?

Experience:

* SEO: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

description:
Job ID \- **1112**


### **Job Description**

**Job Summary**


We are looking for a Market Analyst who can support business, sales, and marketing decisions through strong market research and data analytics.

  

The role involves studying industries, identifying target customer segments, analysing competitors, building lead databases, tracking market trends, and converting raw data into clear business insights. The candidate should be able to work with research data, sales data, marketing performance data, and customer information to support strategy, campaigns, and business growth.

  

This role is not limited to preparing reports. We are looking for someone who can understand the market, identify opportunities, analyse patterns, and present insights that help the company take better decisions.

 **Skills Required**

**Market Research \& Opportunity Analysis**


Industry research, competitor benchmarking, market gap analysis, pricing research, TAM/SAM/SOM, ICP creation, customer segmentation, geography mapping, and opportunity mapping.

**Data Analytics \& Insight Generation**


Data collection, data cleaning, data validation, data interpretation, trend analysis, correlation analysis, forecasting basics, and business insight generation.

**Sales, Marketing \& Customer Analytics**


Lead source analysis, campaign performance analysis, funnel analysis, conversion tracking, CAC analysis, pipeline analysis, customer acquisition trends, retention analysis, churn analysis.

 **Tools**

**Data \& Analytics Tools:** Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio.

**Research \& Market Intelligence Tools:** Google Trends, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Crunchbase, MCA Data, ZaubaCorp, industry reports, company websites, and public databases.

**Digital \& Marketing Analytics Tools:** Google Analytics, social media analytics platforms, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Analytics, YouTube Analytics.

 **Education**


MBA in Marketing, Business Analytics, Strategy, or related fields preferred.


Candidates with a background in BBA, B.Com, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or Computer Applications can also apply if they have strong analytical and research skills.

  

Experience: 0\-4 years
